typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter3a_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Inventory as string,
		origin as string,
		RangeGroup as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter2a
fromtblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter2a derive(rowCreateDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> addrowCreateDate
addrowCreateDate sink(input(
		rowCreateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		origin as string,
		RangeGroup as string,
		Inventory as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		rowCreateDate,
		origin,
		RangeGroup,
		Inventory),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter3a_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter3a
